ventures.name: .mdeck
ventures.one_liner: Write slides in plain text and instantly preview a clean presentation layout.
ventures.for_whom: People who make a quick throwaway deck every week and would rather type than drag boxes.
ventures.design: product-first: the first design, dark, editor and live preview as the first screen; the sample deck is the pitch

ventures.name: Docscope
ventures.one_liner: Drop a .docx, .xlsx or .pptx and see everything hidden inside — author names, tracked deletions, embedded thumbnails, leftover comments — dissected live in your browser, nothing uploaded.
ventures.for_whom: Consultants, lawyers, journalists and developers who email Office files and want to know exactly what metadata and draft remnants they're about to leak (or need to parse).
ventures.design: retro OS: a classic desktop-window metaphor (title bars, bevels, pixel accents) used with restraint

ventures.name: Doodleloop
ventures.one_liner: Drop in a drawing or photo, pick a motion style, and walk away with a looping animated GIF in under a minute — no app, no account, nothing uploaded.
ventures.for_whom: A parent who just photographed their kid's latest crayon masterpiece taped to the fridge and wants to text the family a version where the rocket actually wiggles and the sun really shines.
ventures.design: product-first: the tool fills the first screen and the look follows the product

ventures.name: Dollhouse
ventures.one_liner: Drag out your floor plan, drop in furniture, and get a clean isometric diorama of your actual room you can send to anyone in under a minute.
ventures.for_whom: Someone who just signed a lease (or is about to rearrange) and is arguing with their partner or roommate about whether the couch fits along that wall.
ventures.design: product-first: the tool fills the first screen and the look follows the product

ventures.name: Anthem
ventures.one_liner: Anthem turns any name into an 8-bar theme song you can play, remix, and send to a friend — entirely in the browser, nothing uploaded.
ventures.for_whom: The friend in the group chat who wants to do better than 'HBD 🎉' — they type the birthday person's name and send back their personal theme song.
ventures.design: product-first: the tool fills the first screen and the look follows the product
